title: DemandSight: Retail Sales Analytics
description: DemandSight — Retail Sales Analytics Retail transaction data (orders, products, regions, profit) is hard to explore without SQL or Excel pivots Turn the bundled Superstore CSV into an instant, zero-install analytics dashboard Analysts, store managers, students learning data analytics KPIs, time-series charts, category/region breakdowns, product rankings — all from real data
problem_solved:
The upstream repo ships a MySQL-based SQL query kit. Running it requires database setup,
Python dependencies, and manual query execution — a high bar for a single CSV. Non-technical
users cannot see sales/profit patterns at all without that infrastructure.
target_audience: Intermediate learners with basic Python familiarity; some projects require additional math, data, or system prerequisites.
prerequisites: Introductory probability and supervised learning; read the project prerequisite guide for project-specific needs
learning_outcomes: Explain the implementation stages of DemandSight: Retail Sales Analytics using named source files.
Separate model or algorithm behavior from its interface, data pipeline, and configured dependencies.
Inspect likely failure modes, metrics, limitations, privacy, and human-review needs appropriate to the application.
Propose a reproducible, source-aligned extension and test plan.
estimated_completion_time: 18–30 hours, depending on optional data/model downloads
